live-v2-run1.note: Scored run (D510), run 1 of the two pre-registered: the agent from examples/adk-agent as at the D510 commit, on Gemini 3.8 Flash through an OpenAI-compatible LiteLLM gateway to Gemini, against https://undelabs.dev/mcp anonymously, products a01-a12, one run each, three at a time, 22 Nov 2026 10:30-10:40 +08:00. From about 10:39:50 the live server refused this address's model calls with 429 client_budget_reached (the anonymous per-client share of the day's model budget, which reopens at 00:00 UTC): a09's plan search, a10's part codes and a11's and a12's extraction were refused, so those four runs stopped early. Kept and scored as the rules say; see D511. Run 2 could not start for the same reason. Changed after the run: the scorer reads "NY N" and "HQ H" as the ruling number (norm_one, D511). It changes one row: a06 named "NY N340438", which the scorer had read as NN340438 and counted as invented; a06 passes under both rule sets after the fix and failed before. The headline: all 8 runs the budget did not touch (a01-a08) passed; 9 of 12 as scored, a09 passing because the agent reported the refused plan call and stopped.
